note: Evil Mode slice 21, the edges (design Part 27 section 4: Incursions for a Boss; Part 5 section 8 and Part 16 section 6: the Shadow branch). Numbers are starting values, not playtested.

appetites.dependence: Jobs the Boss went on in person because nobody else could be trusted with them.
appetites.charge: Funds sat on: every Evening over ₽20,000.
appetites.patience: Quiet days: an Evening with nothing sent.
appetites.formation: Standing squads: the same squad out three times in a district.
appetites.spectacle: Loud days: Heat +2 or more in a day.
appetites.longing: People who left and weren't written to.

static.title: Static
static.lead: Nothing on the Board. Everything else is slightly off.
static.radio: The Radio: the presenter reads the item, stops, and reads it again, word for word, and doesn't notice.
static.bark: {name}, by the window: "Did the light just— no. Never mind."
static.kit: One of {name}'s Pokémon won't go back in its Ball today. Something's listening.
static.cat: The cat is on top of the highest thing in the building.
static.knockKiele: Kiele, at the door: "I've logged three lights that weren't stars. This is a fourth. It's over us."
static.knock: {name}, down from the roof: "There's a light over us. It isn't a star."

tear.title: A Tear
tear.opens: A Tear opens over {holding}. {who} is standing in the road looking at it.
tear.rule: {rule} It's in every battle in the district: the team's and everybody else's.
tear.pays: {holding} pays nothing while it's open. Its street pays half.

card.name: A TEAR · {holding} · THE DAY
card.moves: Regard or Dread, by {n}, by what's done in the next {days} days.
card.wont: Nobody's said no. Nobody's said anything.
card.holds: It holds for {days} days. Then something comes out.
card.hero: The kid's here too. For three days you're in the same street for the same reason.
card.written: Day {day}. {holding}. A hole in the sky. The team {did}.
card.other: There isn't another way. There's what you do, and what comes out.

who.district: The district asks the team what it's going to do. Whatever you've been to them, you're the nearest thing to somebody in charge.
who.detective: The detective arrives without the list: "I'm not here about you. For once." Heat can't rise while it's open.

neighbour.giovanni: Giovanni sends six men with rope and no questions.
neighbour.archer: Archer sends a note: "The Boss would want to know what it is. So do I."
neighbour.archie: Archie comes down to the water to see it, and says it'd look better over the sea.
neighbour.maxie: Maxie sends a memo asking for measurements.
neighbour.other: The neighbour sends a message. It asks what you're going to do.

who.hero: The kid comes. Of course they do.
who.looker: Looker. He's done this before. He doesn't ask who the Boss is. He asks who's the best door-holder you've got.

through.label: Go through
through.sub: In person: the Beast's home world, its law, a fight. It can be calmed, caught or left.

together.label: (Go through together.)
together.sub: With the kid. Two parties, the Tear's law on both.
together.did: went through it with the kid

hold.label: Hold the street
hold.sub: Six off every other job for three days. Nobody goes near; it comes out anyway, to an empty street.

leave.label: Leave it
leave.sub: Nothing. The Beast takes the district's next battle, whoever's it was meant to be.

why.inPerson: Going through is In person: wait for the beat.
why.used: The Boss has already been out today.
why.together: Only when the kid's Set or worse.
why.six: Six people need to be free to hold the street.

tear.holding: {name} is holding the street by the Tear.
tear.won: It's gone back. The sky over {holding} closes like a door.
tear.caught: It's in a ball, and it's ours, and it doesn't want to be here.
tear.lost: It threw you out. The Tear's still open.
tear.together: We've fought something together. I've not forgotten.
tear.togetherFile: Fought the thing in the Tear beside the Boss. Hasn't said what it changes.
tear.heldOut: On the third day it comes out. The street's empty. Nobody's hurt, and the district saw the team stand there.
tear.comesOut: On the third day it comes out. It goes looking for a fight.
tear.incursion: Something from somewhere else is waiting at {holding}. The Card said "We don't know."
tear.metSquad: {squad} met something from somewhere else at {holding}. Nobody won. It went back.
tear.fought: It's gone. Whatever it was, it's gone back.

flaws.doubts: {name}: "Does it want to be here? Has anybody asked?"
flaws.proud: {name}: "It's ours. It chose us." It didn't.
flaws.other: {name} walks the long way round it.

beast.home: {beast} is in the building: {room} Homesick {n} of 10.
beast.falls: It stays while the team does what drew it.
beast.leaves: {beast} left in the night: through the roof. There's a hole in the ceiling. Faye mends it and leaves a skylight.
beast.poipole: Poipole turned up in the Barracks this morning, asleep on an empty bed. It can't be sent on a job.
beast.plated: Somebody's put a plate out for it. It ate everything, and the plate.
beast.notScheme: A Beast's never a Means, a Key or a part. It isn't from here. The stamps don't know what to call it.

shadow.title: The Shadow branch
shadow.never: Corruption only rises. It's the only number in the mode that only goes one way.
shadow.allows: Everything Grey allows, and the Shadow branch: Capture Rigs, the Shadow Lab, Shadow orders. Corruption only rises.
shadow.lineSevenRemoved: Won't be on anything that shuts a heart.

rig.label: Set a Capture Rig: {holding}
rig.sub: Kits for six Grunts, from one holding, in a day. The ground's empty for the rest of the region.
rig.card: Takes: every Pokémon on the hill. From: the hill.
rig.said: The Rig ran all night. In the morning there were six kits in the yard and nothing on the hill.
rig.log: Day {day}. {holding}. A Capture Rig. Every Pokémon on the hill, taken. Heat +4, Dread +2.
rig.stripped: Stripped. It supplies nothing for the rest of the region.

lab.assigned: Nobody volunteers. {name}'s Loyalty is lowest. {name} runs the Lab.
knock: {name}, at the door: "I've stopped looking at the cards."
lab.through: {n} more through the Lab. Their hearts are shut. Kits at +2 levels, with Shadow moves.
lab.shutSub: No more goes in. The room's still there.
lab.shutSaid: No more goes in. A sheet's been hung over the door; nobody ordered that.
lab.relieveSub: The Lab stands empty and does nothing. Corruption doesn't fall.
lab.relieved: {name} hands back the key. Their Loyalty rises to 5, and no further.
lab.purifySub: In person, by the main game's means. Regard +1; a person's Bond comes back. The figure stays where it is.
lab.purified: One's itself again, and remembers. Corruption stays where it is.
lab.noneLeft: Nothing's come out of the Lab that isn't itself already.
lab.card: Takes: what it was. From: a Pokémon, by name.

orders.label: (A Shadow order.)
orders.sub: The Pokémon goes without its person. A person's line doesn't bind their Pokémon.
orders.said: {name} doesn't go. Their Pokémon does. It does what it's told.
orders.none: Nothing from the Lab to send.

ladder.text: The figure appears. One person's left: they said why, in the doorway, to everyone.
Loyalty's ceiling: 8. Applicants with Heart stop coming. The Mess is quieter.
Loyalty's ceiling: 6. The command party looks at the Boss differently.
Going Straight and The Recruit are closed. The detective stops asking questions.

shadow.doorway: {name}, in the doorway, to everyone: "I came for the work. Not for that."
shadow.lineLeave: {name} won't stay for that. Their line was "{line}".
